target: actual home margin minus the rating state’s own prediction (rating gap + league home-field advantage), taken BEFORE the game was absorbed
feature: home opening quarterback’s career-to-date quality minus the away opener’s, both measured only from games already processed and shrunk toward the league mean by n/(n+100)

decision: ypd is the better of the two and it did NOT earn its keep out of sample (held-out MAE fell by 0.0277 points a game, 3 of 7 folds improved). points_applied is false and the QB layer contributes zero to the spread, which is what it did before this job existed
